crossRefs.note: “ ‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in…
You shall do this to them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies…

parallels.note: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.
You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

translations.web: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water. Then he shall be clean.
translations.bsb: On the seventh day he must shave off all his hair—his head, his beard, his eyebrows, and the rest of his hair. He must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and he will be clean.
translations.kjv: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
translations.asv: And it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
